acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated on in data-dependent acquisition mode (top 15 method).
alkylation reagent: alkilated with 50 mM IAA (iodoacetamide) in 20 mM ammonium bicarbonate.
alkylation concentration: alkilated with 50 mM IAA (iodoacetamide) in 20 mM ammonium bicarbonate.
cleavage agent: Immunoprecipitated material was digested with trypsin
enrichment method: immunoprecipitated endogenous, GFP-tagged BUB-1 from embryo lysates using a GFP nanobody.
fractionation method: IP samples were run on 4–12% Bis–Tris sodium dodecyl sulfate gels with MOPS running buffer
instrument: coupled with a Q-Exactive Plus Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
ionization type: Sample was transferred to mass spectrometer via an Easy-Spray source
reduction reagent: Samples were reduced with 10 mM DTT in 20 mM ammonium bicarbonate
reduction concentration: Samples were reduced with 10 mM DTT in 20 mM ammonium bicarbonate
